notes.title: Update Notes - March 31st, 2023 (v2.1.7)
notes.content:

[*] Updated to Discord.js v13.14.0.
[*] [b]Invite Create[/b] and [b]Invite Delete[/b] are two new events that trigger upon the creation or deletion of a server invite.

[*] Fixed issue where Discord.js version check was wrong.

[*] Fixed [b]On Time Restricted Command[/b] triggering inaccurately.

notes.title: Update Notes - September 2nd, 2022 (v2.1.6)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added [b]Await Message from Member[/b] to handle response messages.
[*] Added "[Starts/Ends] With" and "Length is [Equals/Less Than/Greater Than]" conditions to [b]Check Variable[/b].
[*] Added [b]Message Content[/b] intent to [b]Bot Intents[/b] extension.
[*] If any command is of type "Text Command", "Includes Word", "Regular Expression", or "Any Message" and the "Message Content" intent is not enabled, an error message will be printed in the bot log.*
[/list]

* Note: as of September 1st, 2022, if your bot needs to read messages, Discord requires bots to have the "MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT" enabled. As a result, make sure the intent is checked in the Discord Developer Portal and [i]Discord Bot Maker -> Extensions -> Bot Intents -> Message Content[/i] is checked. Since some commands (Text Commands, Includes Word, etc.) require the bot to read the content of messages, this may be required.

Otherwise, if you're using Slash Commands or Menu Commands, you have nothing to worry about!

notes.title: Discord Bot Maker 2.0 Released!
notes.content:
Version 2.0 is now the main version of Discord Bot Maker! Check out all the new available features for Discord Bots in this new update!

[h2]IMPORTANT![/h2]
Before anything, please note that existing projects created in Discord Bot Maker v1.6 and below may not work in v2.0. It is HIGHLY recommended you create a new project when switching to v2.0. You can still maintain old projects by selecting to use "Old/Legacy 1.6" on start-up in Steam. If your project does not use any third-party mods, it may be compatible with v2.0, but be sure to make a back-up of the project folder before attempting to update!!

[i]NOTE[/i]: If you would like to permanently stay on the old version of Discord Bot Maker, you can select it from the BETAS menu (RIght-click DBM > Properties... > BETAS > old_version_v1.6).

[h2]"DBM WON'T OPEN"[/h2]
Due to some issues with how Steam handles different launch options, you may have some trouble opening Discord Bot Maker before the update. If you're having issues, try uninstalling and reinstalling Discord Bot Maker to force Steam to update itself.

[h2]V2.0 CHANGES[/h2]
There are A LOT of changes. More than I could possibly list here. So just the major changes will be listed, but please note there may be minor bug fixes and changes that were also made that are not listed below:

[h3]Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] The design and style of the editor has been enhanced!
[*] There is now a tab system and better modal system that can even be used in third-party mods!
[*] The software now runs on Electron.
[*] The editor will now inform users if their actions are out of date and provide a prompt to update them.
[/list]

[h3]Folders[/h3]
[list]
[*] Commands and Events can now be organized using folders.
[*] The folder text can be configured by color, italics, bold, underline, and strikethrough. 
[*] A Semantic UI icon can also be used. Please visit this page for a list of options (https://semantic-ui.com/elements/icon.html)
[/list]

[h3]New Command Types[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Slash Command[/b] is now the new default. It creates a command that can be accessed using a foward slash (/) in text chat on Discord.
[*] [b]User Menu Command[/b] creates a command that can be activated by right-clicking on a user and choosing it from the menu.
[*] [b]Msg. Menu Command[/b] creates a command that can be activated by right-clicking on a message and choosing it from the menu.
[*] Sub commands can also be created. Simply choose [b]Slash Command[/b] and put spaces in the command's name. Discord Bot Maker will then automatically generate the command and sub-commands required for the command name to work as it appears in the editor.
[/list]

[h3]Partials[/h3]
[list]
[*] This is a new system of restrictions added for Discord Bots. Your partials can be configured using the [b]Bot Partials[/b] extension (Extensions > Bot Partials). Configuring your partials is now necessary for bots to be able to send DMs.
[/list]

[h3]More Context Menu Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] There are now more inputs on the right-click menu when creating a message.
[*] [b]Command/Button User[/b] now works based on whomever triggered the button.
[*] [b]Button Name[/b] provides the triggered button's name.
[*] [b]Button URL[/b] provides the url of the triggered button.
[*] [b]Select Menu Placeholder[/b] provides the placeholder text of the select menu that triggered the action.
[/list]

[h3]Title Menu Updaters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Project > Reset/Reinstall Default Node Modules" for resetting and installing all the node modules.
[*] Added "File > Update Bot.js" to update the bot.js manually.
[/list]

[h3]Upgraded Discord Input Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tons of inputs for actions can now take in a name/ID for the desired input (channel, role, send-target, etc.).
[*] [b]Send To[/b] and [b]Channel[/b] drop-downs now include Rules Channel and Join/Boost Notify Channel.
[*] [b]Server[/b] drop-downs can now select a Discord Server based on name or ID.
[*] [b]Send To[/b] now has a [b]Button User or Select Menu User[/b] input.
[*] [b]Delete Channel[/b] and [b]Edit Any Channel[/b] have inputs for both text and voice.
[/list]

[h3]Send Message Is Upgraded![/h3]
[list]
[*] There are now tabs: [b]Message[/b], [b]Embeds[/b], [b]Buttons[/b], [b]Selects[/b], [b]Files[/b], and [b]Settings[/b]
[*] [b]Embeds[/b] allows for a list input of multiple embeds to be sent with the message.
[*] [b]Buttons[/b] allows for a list of buttons to be sent with the message.
[*] The settings for the buttons, how they look, and what actions they run can be configured in the button window.
[*] [b]Selects[/b], same with buttons, allows for a list of select menus to be sent with the message.
[*] The settings for the selects, which options they have, and what actions they run can be configured in the button window.
[*] [b]Files[/b] can now be attached in Send Message.
[*] In the settings, [b]Reply to Interaction if Possible[/b] configures whether this message counts as an interaction response.
[*] [b]Make Reply Private (Ephemeral)[/b] will make the message appear only for the command user (message must be an interaction response).
[*] Added "Text-to-Speech" setting
[*] [b]Overwrite Changes[/b], [b]Don't Send Message[/b], and [b]Message/Options to Edit[/b] allow users to save the message data without sending it.
[*] Alternatively, existing messages can be edited by supplying them to the [b]Message/Options to Edit[/b] input.
[*] Inputting a variable containing a message to the [b]Send To[/b] input will make the [b]Send Message[/b] reply to this message.
[*] And finally, like before, [b]Store In[/b] can store the message sent, OR store the message data is [b]Don't Send Message[/b] is checked.
[/list]

[h3]Thread Actions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Create Thread[/b] action to create a thread from a channel or message.
[*] Added [b]Find Thread[/b] to find an existing thread.
[*] Added [b]Archive Thread[/b] to archive a thread.
[*] Added [b]Store Thread Channel Info[/b] to store information regarding the thread in a variable.
[/list]

[h3]Containers and Loops[/h3]
[list]
[*] Actions can now contain lists of actions inside of them. This allows for new ways to organize actions.
[*] Added [b]Action Container[/b]. This action simply runs the actions inside of it. Think of it as an action folder.
[*] [b]Loop Through Numbers[/b], [b]Loop Through List[/b], and [b]Loop Through All Servers[/b] now allow for the looping actions to be input directly inside the actions themselves.
[/list]

[h3]Better Custom Emoji Support[/h3]
[list]
[*] The right-click menu now has better support for custom emojis.
[*] [b]Insert Custom Emoji[/b] provides a template to find an emoji based on its name.
[*] [b]Insert Flag Emoji[/b] provides a template to insert one of the flag emojis based on their name.
[*] [b]Convert Text to Emojis[/b] is a convenient function for transforming normal text into emoji text. 
[/list]

[h3]Anchor Actions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Based on their popularity in third-party mods, action anchors are added.
[*] The [b]Action Anchor[/b] is an action that you can place where you'd like the flow of actions to begin when moved.
[*] The [b]Go To Action Anchor[/b] action moves the action flow from its current position to the provided action anchor location.
[/list]

[h3][i]Show Modal[/i] action[/h3]
[list]
[*] This shows a pop-up window that allows the command user to input text into custom text fields.
[*] The text field data is then stored into temporary variables that can be used with following actions.
[/list]

[h3][i]Edit Any Channel[/i] action[/h3]
[list]
[*] This is a powerful new action that allows for Text, Voice, and Thread channel to be modified. Using the tab system, the unique properties of each type of channel can be modified with ease.
[/list]

[h3][i]Bot One-Time Initialization[/i] event[/h3]
[list]
[*] This even runs once and only once no matter how many servers the bot is in.
[/list]

[h3][i]Timeout Member[/i] action[/h3]
[list]
[*] Timeout's a server member using the new [b]Timeout[/b] Discord feature.
[/list]

[h3][i]Disable Command[/i] action[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disables a slash command or user/message command.
[/list]

[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Invalid Button Response[/b] for when a button is no longer valid.
[*] Added [b]Invalid Select Menu Response[/b] for when a select in no longer valid.
[*] Added [b]Invalid User Response[/b] for commands run by a user without the proper permissions.
[*] Added [b]Auto-Leave Voice Channel Delay (Seconds)[/b].
[*] Added [b]Auto-Defean on Voice Channel Join[/b].
[*] Added [b]Allow Bot Volume Changing in Actions[/b] to help optimize audio based on whether volume will change.
[/list]

[h3]Editor Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added configuration for how the content of the software fits the window.
[*] Added zoom accessibility option.
[*] Added configuration for whether deleting requires verification through pop-up window.
[*] Reworked title-menu options to be check-boxes in editor settings section.
[/list]

[h3]Slash Command Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Slash Command Creation Preference[/b] configures how slash commands are applied. Press the (?) button for more info inside DBM.
[*] Added [b]Clear Server Commands for Unlisted Servers[/b]
[*] Added [b]Ignore "Missing Access" Errors for Servers Without Command Scope[/b] to help with existing bots without command capabilities.
[*] Added [b]Default Slash Command Response[/b] for when a response is not generated with actions.
[*] Added [b]No Description Text[/b] for commands with no descriptions applied.
[*] Added [b]Invalid Permissions Response[/b] for commands called with invalid permissions.
[*] Added [b]Time Restriction Enforced Response[/b] for configuration over time restriction.
[/list]

[h3]Text Command Options [/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved to a separate tab.
[/list]

notes.title: Discord Bot Maker v1.2.0 "List and Loops" Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29866725/66d0a6896f5153edd222d9f0c94789550bbc6db5.png[/img]

A couple days ago, the 1.2.0 update for Discord Bot Maker was released!

Here are all the new features:

[h1]Variable Tracker[/h1]
Any variable name input now includes a dropdown/autocomplete function allowing users to reference previously defined variables. A list of variables is now also accessable from the right-click menu!

[h1]Added 24 More Events[/h1]
The rest of the Discord API's events have been added! Events may now request users to input two variable names. Please enjoy!

[h1]Added new "List and Loops" Action Section[/h1]
The new List and Loops actions will allow users to create complex algorithms for bulk item manipulations. For example, one may create a loop that repeats the same event throughout the context of each server the bot is within. One may also repeat an event for each existing role/channel/member within a specific server. The possibilities are endless!

[h1]Added More Server Actions[/h1]
[u]Find Server[/u]
Can find any of the servers the bot is within
[u]Store Server Info[/u]
Takes information from a server and stores it within a variable

[h1]Added More Conditions[/h1]
[u]Check If Member has Role[/u]
Checks if a server member has a role
[u]Check Member Permissions[/u]
Checks if a server member has a permission

[h1]Call Command/Event[/h1]
Commands and events can now be called from other commands and events synchronously or asynchronously!

[h1]Create Invite[/h1]
An invite link can now be created from a server channel.

[h1]Edit Message[/h1]
Bots are now capable of editing their own messages!

[h1]Case-Sensitivity Control[/h1]
Users may choose whether or not commands will be case-sensitive.

[h1]Parameter Separator Control[/h1]
Users may now provide their own Regular Expression to be used for parsing parameters from commands.

[h1]Data Encryption[/h1]
Users can now provide an encryption key to be used to encrypt data.

[h1]Bot Owner Only Restriction[/h1]
Commands can now have a restriction placed on them requiring the user be the owner of the bot.

[h1]Auto Restart Option[/h1]
Developers now have the option to automatically restart the bot if the bot is turned on and the developer saves. This is very convenient for testing!

[h1]Manual Updating[/h1]
One may manually choose to update their project by clicking [i]File -> Update Bot Project[/i]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To see things in action, check out this quick demonstration video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HdxJo4C5pw4
Thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoy! 
~ Discord Bot Maker Dev

Checks if a server member has a role
[u]Check Member Permissions[/u]
Checks if a server member has a permission

Call Command/Event
Commands and events can now be called from other commands and events synchronously or asynchronously!

Create Invite
An invite link can now be created from a server channel.

Edit Message
Bots are now capable of editing their own messages!

Case-Sensitivity Control
Users may choose whether or not commands will be case-sensitive.

Parameter Separator Control
Users may now provide their own Regular Expression to be used for parsing parameters from commands.

Data Encryption
Users can now provide an encryption key to be used to encrypt data.

Bot Owner Only Restriction
Commands can now have a restriction placed on them requiring the user be the owner of the bot.

Auto Restart Option
Developers now have the option to automatically restart the bot if the bot is turned on and the developer saves. This is very convenient for testing!

Manual Updating
One may manually choose to update their project by clicking [i]File -> Update Bot Project[/i]

notes.title: Discord Bot Maker v1.1.0 Update Released!
notes.content:
While it has only been a couple days since the release of Discord Bot Maker, there has been tons of user feedback! With this feedback, many upgrades to the software have been added over the past couple days. However, just now, the largest update has been set live!

This update includes:

[h1]Project Templates[/h1]
When creating a new project, one may now select from a pre-built template containing example Commands and Events for the user to explore! There are currently four templates, but over time more will be added when necessary!

[h1]Dragging/Moving[/h1]
In order to organize Commands, Events, or Actions, all you must do is drag them! Drag one on top of another to move it to the new position. It's that simple!

[h1]Storing Data[/h1]
Data may now be directly stored into Variables using the new "Store Member Data" and "Store Server Data" actions!

[h1]New Exit Prompt[/h1]
Previously, the software would either give you the choice of "Saving" or "Not Saving" when leaving the program. It did not give the option to "Cancel" in case the user accidentally clicked the exit button. This has been resolved by adding a new exit prompt with all three options available!

[h1]Easy Action Edit[/h1]
Double clicking on an Action will now open the editing window for it.

[h1]Automatic Project Updating[/h1]
If your project is out of date, the software will detect this and prompt you to update the project. If the user agrees to update, it will be done instantaneously! 

[h1]More Member Info[/h1]
You may now store a member's Game, Status, or Avatar URL!

[h1]Conditional Skipping[/h1]
You may now skip succeeding commands in Conditions as opposed to jumping to them directly.

[h1]Regular Expression Checking[/h1]
Certain Conditions now allow for the use of Regular Expressions.

[h1]Right-Click Text Template Insertion (added in v1.0.5)[/h1]
By right-clicking on any text input within the action window, one may select from a list of pre-built evals representing significant mentions or variables the user may wish to use!

[h1]Exporting Raw Data (added in v1.0.6)[/h1]
Data for Commands or Events can be exported to plain text. This text can be used to import the corresponding feature into another project.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To see things in action, check out this quick demonstration video:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cyoe0irAOrw]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cyoe0irAOrw[/url]
Thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoy! 
 ~ Discord Bot Maker Dev

notes.title: Discord Bot Maker Released!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you everyone for your patience!
Discord Bot Maker is finally released! Hope you all enjoy![/b]

If you like it, I hope you will find time to give it a like; otherwise, I hope you'll let me know any critiques you have with it, and give me an oppurtunity to resolve them!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now, before purchasing the application, here's a couple things you should know:

[h1]Documentation[/h1]
To start, the software does not have any documentation or tutorials released yet. This should not be too big of a deal, as much of the functionality within Discord Bot Maker is self-explanatory; however, some of the more advanced features take some explanation, so I hope you'll bear with me. I originally meant to have a decent "help" section and some tutorials out by the release, but time constraints got in my way. (;^_^)

[h1]Voice Support[/h1]
Secondly, the Discord Bot Maker currently does not have any support for "voice channels". This is a planned feature for the future that unfortunately could not be added due to, once again, time constraints and other minor complications. It's only fair that I let you know about this as it is planned to be included as soon as possible!

[h1]Minor Bugs[/h1]
Finally, for those that are early purchasers, you may encounter some bugs. I can't imagine anything huge, as I have spent considerable amounts of time testing the program. However, I am a one-man team, so it's only natural that I may have missed a couple things. If you do encounter any issues, please report them to the [url=https://discord.gg/ZubxqbW]Discord Bot Maker server[/url]!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once again, thank you all for your support, and I hope you all enjoy!
~ Discord Bot Maker Dev
